name: smart-ai
description: منصة تدريب ذكية على Firebase مع Claude

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.seed:local: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 npm --prefix functions run seed -- --project demo-smart-ai
scripts.dev: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-smart-ai npm --prefix web run dev
